Layout map objects

Source: R/zz-gen-layout.R
go_map.Rd

The object for the figure layout's map (and map2, map3, ...: see update_maps()). go_map() creates one, with exactly its properties; a named list with the same properties works too.

Usage

go_map(
  ...,
  bearing = NULL,
  bounds = NULL,
  center = NULL,
  domain = NULL,
  fitbounds = NULL,
  layers = NULL,
  pitch = NULL,
  style = NULL,
  uirevision = NULL,
  zoom = NULL,
  skip_invalid = FALSE
)

Arguments

...

Not for properties, which must be named in full: an abbreviated or unknown name is an error that suggests the right one.

bearing

Sets the bearing angle of the map in degrees counter-clockwise from North (map.bearing). Number.

bounds

A go_map_bounds() object or named list, with properties east, north, south and west (see go_map_bounds()).

center

A go_map_center() object or named list, with properties lat and lon (see go_map_center()).

domain

A go_domain() object or named list, with properties column, row, x and y (see go_domain()).

fitbounds

Determines if this subplot's view settings are auto-computed to fit trace data. If "locations" (default), the view is auto-fit to the lon/lat coordinates of the visible trace data. If FALSE, the view settings are used as-is; set this to opt out of auto-fitting. If `fitbounds` is enabled but a user provides `center` or `zoom`, auto-fit will be skipped. One of "locations", FALSE.

layers

List, each element a go_map_layer() object or named list, with properties below, circle, color, coordinates, fill, line, maxzoom, minzoom, name, opacity, source, sourceattribution and 6 more (see go_map_layer()).

pitch

Sets the pitch angle of the map (in degrees, where 0 means perpendicular to the surface of the map) (map.pitch). Number.

style

Defines the map layers that are rendered by default below the trace layers defined in `data`, which are themselves by default rendered below the layers defined in `layout.map.layers`. These layers can be defined either explicitly as a Map Style object which can contain multiple layer definitions that load data from any public or private Tile Map Service (TMS or XYZ) or Web Map Service (WMS) or implicitly by using one of the built-in style objects which use WMSes or by using a custom style URL Map Style objects are of the form described in the MapLibre GL JS documentation available at https://maplibre.org/maplibre-style-spec/ The built-in plotly.js styles objects are: basic, carto-darkmatter, carto-darkmatter-nolabels, carto-positron, carto-positron-nolabels, carto-voyager, carto-voyager-nolabels, dark, light, open-street-map, outdoors, satellite, satellite-streets, streets, white-bg. Any value.

uirevision

Controls persistence of user-driven changes in the view: `center`, `zoom`, `bearing`, `pitch`. Defaults to `layout.uirevision`. Any value.

zoom

Sets the zoom level of the map (map.zoom). Number.

skip_invalid

If TRUE, silently drop invalid properties instead of raising an error.

Value

A go_layout_map object (a named list).

Details

Nested objects are named lists, or objects of the constructors their arguments name. Every property is checked against the plotly.js schema when the object is created or modified. A property may be a one-sided formula (color = ~col): it is kept, and evaluated in the data (then checked) when its trace is added to a figure with add_<trace>() or add_trace().

Examples

quakes |>
  go_figure() |>
  add_scattermap(lat = ~lat, lon = ~long) |>
  update_layout(map = go_map())
